lines.text: Pop quiz. What did you agree to at nine fifteen this morning?
You forgot. Your Mac didn't. LokalBot answers from a private memory of your whole workday, quoting the source.
It captures both sides of your call. Nothing joins the meeting.
Dictate into any app, and Tab accepts autocomplete from a model on your machine.
Built-in processing stays local. No account. No telemetry. Check the network yourself.
Your workday, remembered. Free at lokalbot dot com.

bgm.blob: LokalBot remembers your workday and answers with proof, on-device by default
bgm.arc: Demo Loop (challenge-hook variant) — quiz → instant answer → demo cycles → trust proof → CTA
